value.rationale: The theorem identifies a mathematically natural first-occurrence boundary for spherical second-independence topology in the canonical family of circular ladders. Four preceding lengths have large Euler-characteristic obstructions, while length seven has a complete S5 homotopy reduction; the cutoff and homotopy type are meaningful exact invariants, not an arbitrary parameter slice. It supplies a test case for future periodic-width-two classifications without asserting a general recurrence.
